name: jcs_empty_object
note: Empty object; surrounding whitespace dropped.

name: jcs_empty_containers
note: Empty array and empty object as values.

name: jcs_whitespace_all_four_kinds
note: Only space, tab, LF, CR are JSON whitespace; all removed.

name: jcs_key_order_ascii
note: Plain code-unit order: '1' < 'A' < '_' < 'a' < 'aa' < 'b' (shorter prefix first).

name: jcs_empty_key_sorts_first
note: Empty string is a legal key and sorts first.

name: jcs_key_with_nul_between_prefix_and_longer
note: Addendum 4 §4: a key containing a C0 control character (here U+0000) is refused. Sort coverage moved to jcs_key_with_space_and_del_around_longer.

name: jcs_key_with_space_and_del_around_longer
note: 'a' < 'a ' (0020, the lowest non-C0 code unit) < 'ab' < 'a\u007f' (DEL sorts after 'b'): the shorter prefix first. DEL is not C0 and is written raw, not escaped.

name: jcs_rfc8785_sort_example_strings
input_json: {"\u20ac":"Euro Sign","\r":"Carriage Return","\ufb33":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh","1":"One","\ud83d\ude00":"Emoji: Grinning Face","\u0080":"Control","\u00f6":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis"}
note: Addendum 4 §4: the RFC 8785 §3.2.3 example has a "\r" key, a C0 control character, so it is refused. Sort coverage moved to jcs_rfc8785_sort_example_space_key.

name: jcs_rfc8785_sort_example_space_key
input_json: {"\u20ac":"Euro Sign"," ":"Space","\ufb33":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh","1":"One","\ud83d\ude00":"Emoji: Grinning Face","\u0080":"Control","\u00f6":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis"}
canonical: {" ":"Space","1":"One","":"Control","ö":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis","€":"Euro Sign","😀":"Emoji: Grinning Face","דּ":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh"}
note: RFC 8785 §3.2.3 sort example with string values, its '\r' key replaced by ' ' (U+0020) per addendum 4 §4; the space still sorts first. U+1F600 (UTF-16 D83D DE00) sorts BEFORE U+FB33: code-unit order, not code-point order. U+0080 is not escaped.

name: jcs_reject_key_escape_char
note: Addendum 4 §4: key U+001B (the key Node v24 JSON.parse can misdecode as a backslash) is refused.

name: jcs_reject_key_c0_short_escape_nested
note: Addendum 4 §4: a C0 key is refused at any depth, inside arrays too, and \t is treated like \u0009.

name: jcs_c0_in_value_and_escaped_backslash_key
note: Addendum 4 §4 applies to keys only: C0 characters in a value pass, and the key here is a literal backslash followed by 'u001b' (no control character).

name: jcs_non_bmp_sorts_before_high_bmp
note: Raw UTF-8 keys. UTF-16 order: 中(4E2D) < 😀(D83D) < 𠀀(D840) < U+E000 < U+FFFD. Code-point order would put E000/FFFD before both non-BMP keys; sorting by code points or by UTF-8 bytes gives a different (wrong) result.

name: jcs_keys_differ_only_in_surrogates
note: Emoji keys sharing or differing in the high surrogate: D83D DE00 < D83D DE01 < D83D DE42 < D83E DD16.

name: jcs_cjk_keys
note: CJK keys: 'z'(007A) < 名(540D) < 名称(540D 79F0) < 标题(6807); prefix shorter first.

name: jcs_key_escape_equivalent
note: Escaped keys are compared after unescaping: \u0062 is 'b', \u00E9 is 'é' (raw in output).

name: jcs_escape_all_c0_controls
note: All U+0000..U+001F written as \uXXXX (mixed hex case). Output: only \b \t \n \f \r use short forms; every other control is \u00xx with lowercase hex.

name: jcs_escape_short_forms_in_input
note: All JSON short escapes in input. Output keeps \b \f \n \r \t \" \\ but '\/' becomes a bare '/'.

name: jcs_solidus_escaped
note: Same digest as jcs_solidus_raw: '/' is never escaped in output.

name: jcs_solidus_raw
note: Same digest as jcs_solidus_escaped.

name: jcs_del_and_c1_not_escaped
note: DEL (U+007F) and C1 controls (U+0080..U+009F) are NOT escaped; they are emitted as raw UTF-8.

name: jcs_u2028_u2029_escaped_input
note: U+2028/U+2029 are emitted raw (UTF-8 E2 80 A8 / E2 80 A9), NOT as \u2028. Go's encoding/json escapes them; do not use it for output. Same digest as jcs_u2028_u2029_raw_input.

name: jcs_u2028_u2029_raw_input
note: Raw U+2028/U+2029 in input; same digest as jcs_u2028_u2029_escaped_input.

name: jcs_html_chars_not_escaped
note: <, >, &, ' are never escaped (Go's default SetEscapeHTML(true) would emit \u003c etc.).

name: jcs_non_ascii_escaped_input
note: Escaped non-ASCII (incl. uppercase-hex surrogate pair) emitted as raw UTF-8: é中😀�. Same digest as jcs_non_ascii_raw_input. U+FFFD itself is valid.

name: jcs_non_ascii_raw_input
note: Raw UTF-8; same digest as jcs_non_ascii_escaped_input.

name: jcs_nfc_precomposed
note: NFC 'café' (U+00E9). Different digest from jcs_nfd_decomposed: JCS does NOT normalize Unicode.

name: jcs_nfd_decomposed
note: NFD 'café' (e + U+0301). Different digest from jcs_nfc_precomposed.

name: jcs_nfc_vs_nfd_keys
note: NFC and NFD forms are DIFFERENT keys (not duplicates); 'e\u0301' (0065) sorts before 'é' (00E9).

name: jcs_quote_and_backslash
note: Quote and backslash re-escaped as \" and \\.

name: jcs_nested_mixed
note: Objects sorted at every depth, including objects inside arrays; array element order preserved.

name: jcs_array_order_preserved
note: Arrays are never sorted or deduplicated.

name: jcs_js_special_keys
note: Keys that are special in JS objects are ordinary strings. JS parsers must keep __proto__ as an own property (JSON.parse does; object spread / zod record rebuilding may drop it).

name: jcs_reject_duplicate_key_same_value
note: Duplicate keys are rejected even with equal values (I-JSON; JSON.parse and Go silently keep the last).

name: jcs_reject_duplicate_key_via_escape
note: \u0061 is 'a': duplicate after unescaping.

name: jcs_reject_duplicate_key_nested
note: Duplicate inside a nested object.

name: jcs_reject_duplicate_key_in_array_object
note: Duplicate inside an object in an array.

name: jcs_reject_lone_high_surrogate
note: Lone high surrogate. JSON.parse accepts it and Raft canonicalJson emits "x\ud83d"; Go decodes it to U+FFFD. Digests would diverge, so the strict parser MUST reject.

name: jcs_reject_lone_low_surrogate
note: Lone low surrogate.

name: jcs_reject_reversed_surrogate_pair_key
note: Key with low+high surrogates in the wrong order (two lone surrogates).

name: jcs_reject_high_surrogate_then_bmp
note: High surrogate followed by a non-surrogate.

name: jcs_number_int
note: Integer at the generic layer: allowed (handle/ticket iat/exp/epoch are numbers).

name: jcs_number_float
note: Short decimal: ES Number formatting gives 1.5.

name: jcs_number_negative_zero
note: -0 canonicalizes to 0 (RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3).

name: jcs_number_exponent
note: 1e2 canonicalizes to 100.

name: jcs_number_fraction_trailing_zeros
note: 2.250 and -2.25e0 canonicalize to 2.25 and -2.25.

name: jcs_true
note: Boolean at the generic layer: allowed (requiresPrepare).

name: jcs_false
note: Nested boolean: allowed.

name: jcs_null
note: null at the generic layer: allowed (not in descriptions).

name: jcs_null_in_array
note: null inside an array: allowed at the generic layer.

name: jcs_handle_payload_shape
note: Shape of a signed handle payload: booleans and integers must survive the generic layer unchanged. Array order is preserved (the signer sorts capabilities itself; JCS does not).

name: jcs_button_descriptor_shape
note: Shape of a Button descriptor D (§3.3) with undoWindowMs as a number.

name: jcs_reject_nan
note: NaN is not JSON.

name: jcs_reject_infinity
note: Infinity is not JSON.

name: jcs_reject_leading_plus
note: Leading '+' is not JSON.

name: jcs_reject_leading_zero
note: Leading zero is not JSON.

name: jcs_reject_raw_control_in_string
note: Raw (unescaped) U+0001 inside a string is invalid JSON.

name: jcs_reject_raw_tab_in_string
note: Raw tab inside a string is invalid JSON (must be \t).

name: jcs_reject_raw_newline_in_string
note: Raw LF inside a string is invalid JSON.

name: jcs_reject_invalid_escape
note: \a is not a JSON escape.

name: jcs_reject_short_unicode_escape
note: Truncated \u escape.

name: jcs_reject_single_quotes
note: Single quotes are not JSON.

name: jcs_reject_trailing_comma
note: Trailing comma.

name: jcs_reject_comment
note: Comments are not JSON.

name: jcs_reject_trailing_garbage
note: Content after the top-level value.

name: jcs_reject_two_values
note: Two top-level values.

name: jcs_reject_bom
note: Leading BOM (U+FEFF) is not JSON whitespace.

name: jcs_reject_nbsp_whitespace
note: U+00A0 is not JSON whitespace.

name: jcs_reject_empty_input
note: Empty input.

name: jcs_reject_unquoted_key
note: Unquoted key.

name: jcs_u_fffd_escaped_is_valid
note: A legitimate escaped U+FFFD MUST be accepted. Go's Decoder.Token returns the same token for this and for the invalid "\ud800"; detect lone surrogates on the raw bytes, never by rejecting U+FFFD. Same digest as jcs_u_fffd_raw_is_valid.

name: jcs_u_fffd_raw_is_valid
note: Raw U+FFFD; same digest as jcs_u_fffd_escaped_is_valid.

name: jcs_noncharacters_escaped
note: Noncharacters U+FFFF, U+FFFE, U+FDD0, U+FDEF, U+1FFFF, U+10FFFF are ACCEPTED by this protocol's input policy (RFC 7493 §2.1 forbids them in strict I-JSON; this protocol is deliberately not a strict I-JSON subset). Emitted raw. Same digest as jcs_noncharacters_raw.

name: jcs_noncharacters_raw
note: Raw noncharacters; same digest as jcs_noncharacters_escaped.

name: jcs_noncharacter_key
note: Noncharacters as keys: allowed; sorted by UTF-16 code units ('a' < U+FDD0 < U+FFFF).
